 WWE star Lola Vice’s “Holaaaa Miamiiiiii” poolside photo shoot
 Aaron Rift October 19, 2026 
 WWE star Lola Vice brought the Miami heat with her “Holaaaa Miamiiiiii” poolside photo shoot! In the pictures, Lola showed off her vibrant look while soaking up the sunshine poolside.
 Multiple WWE stars commented on her photos including Jacy Jayne who wrote, “Hot bitch even tho you almost killed me.” Tiffany Stratton wrote, “Hola babyyyyyy.’
